content.text:
I added `UserRepository.findByEmail(email)` and a test for it. `npm test` passes all 11 tests.

- **`src/repositories/user-repository.js`:** the new method follows the same promise-based style as the other methods in the class. It returns the user with that email, or `null` if there isn't one. Soft-deleted users are left out, which is how the existing callback version in `auth-service.js` behaves, so the service can switch to the repository later without changing behaviour.
- **`tests/repositories.test.js`:** the new test checks that a normal user is found, a soft-deleted user returns `null`, and an unknown email returns `null`.

This follows the rules in `docs/RULES.md`: no service code changed, the new method has a test, and no dependencies were added.
